purpose: T08 calorimetry as a development binding in Python, recipe reco.calo.cell-cluster/1 (decisions.md, U12 A; not a native backend, whose gap stays open): the cell chain of a homogeneous analog grid (pedestal, then gain, which multiplies or divides as its payload states, each step with its payload identity in chain order, raw kept beside calibrated, the readout's saturation flag carried), the clustering of t04-values-v4.md section 7.1 (components, peaks, 30-iteration sharing with fractions kept per object, positions, the section 7.1 uncertainties), the product format calo-cluster-product/1, and /2 for a product made with a calo-gain-payload/1 gain, with a reader of both that refuses a malformed or incomplete product, the gain payload calo-gain-payload/1 with its channel map and derived payloads, the fixed-membership re-evaluation under another gain payload (CAI-T08-1), and on the scoring side the harness that hands out the frozen generator t08-grid/1's events as files, the development readings and the CAI-T08-1 and -2 checks; energy kind clustered deposited energy, never incident energy; optional, required by no skill

tools.name: calo-cluster development binding (Python with NumPy and SciPy)

status_rule: the adapter status is the lowest of its tools' statuses; proposed until a job of record runs it and VALIDATION.md records the run; hand-made events on the login node only so far; no calorimetry quality claim
